# Healthcare test fixtures

These unchanged XML bytes come from [HL7/C-CDA-Examples](https://github.com/HL7/C-CDA-Examples), revision `ad5007abd912a45bbd04ce96e871c70954c2b2c2`, distributed under [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

- `hl7-discharge-summary.xml`: `Documents/Discharge Summary/Discharge_Summary.xml`.
- `hl7-ccd-with-issues.xml`: `Documents/CCD/CCD 2/CCD.xml`.

Only local filenames changed. URLs and digests are in `../../../examples/healthcare/sources.toml`. These copies are exclusively test fixtures: the public examples fetch and use the upstream repositories instead. These are public demonstration documents, not patient records to use clinically. Vendor files are never committed: their redistribution terms are unclear.
